title: High-Performance Computing Network Design
scenario: A research institution needs a VPC architecture optimized for high-performance computing (HPC) workloads. The architecture must support cluster placement groups, high-bandwidth inter-node communication, and access to large datasets in S3. Researchers also need secure remote access to manage jobs.
requirements: Cluster placement group subnet with enhanced networking
Gateway VPC endpoint for high-throughput S3 access (free, no bandwidth limit)
NAT Gateway for software package downloads from the internet
Bastion host or Systems Manager for secure researcher access
Network ACLs restricting traffic to only necessary protocols
Multi-AZ design for management plane with single-AZ for compute (placement group)
